name: clickup-mcp-pro
description: The most complete ClickUp MCP server — 161 typed tools + clickup_raw covering the entire ClickUp v2/v3 API.
author: helbertparanhos

envVars.name: CLICKUP_API_TOKEN
envVars.description: ClickUp Personal API Token (pk_...). Settings → Apps → API Token.

envVars.name: CLICKUP_TEAM_ID
envVars.description: Default Team/Workspace id used when a tool omits team_id.

envVars.name: CLICKUP_READONLY
envVars.description: Set to 'true' to block all write operations.
